page.overview:
Who is Bardbee?

Bardbee was a Rayeth male who was a member of Blue's partisans. He was captured by Imperial Admiral Bethava Rocwyn on the planet Uchinao and interrogated on the space station Five Points. He was eventually tortured and gave up his fellow Partisans before dying in the torment.
